verdict.rationale: The Claude Agent SDK is a developer framework, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows MCP client support (connecting the SDK's agent to external MCP servers) and an in-process MCP server that developers use to build custom tools for their own agent. Neither is an official MCP server that other agents can connect to, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
